method: Fixed spheres: native floor-cell ESDF, physical radius plus one resolution (safe=false). Arm spheres: native trilinear ESDF and physical radius. Recorded diagnostic complete generations bracket actual planning; not claiming exact consumed generation. Current/manual target copies measured joints. No dynamic overlay points in these diagnostic generations.
diagnostic_time_semantics: Diagnostic header[3] is getReadFusionTime(), assigned from occupancy update commit ROS time, NOT the source stamp of the contributing PointCloud2. Historical key fusion_source means this map commit time only; no exact input-frame match is claimed. Header[37] is diagnostic acquisition time.
